scope: Full reading of all ten EN/DE manuscripts, including all supplied Chinese quotations and translations, main arguments, captions, optional readings, edition/image/rights notes and references. Editorial proofreading and internal consistency review, not native-speaker human certification or new museum-image authentication.

changes.details: Clarified that 心 and 念 both involve the form 心, rather than both having 心 below another component.
Repaired an unnatural syntactic construction about ritual not merely repeating its own abstract praise.
Naturalized two literal constructions: one component can extend while another gathers; evidence does not license inventing a weathering story for each mark.
Naturalized the transition from the visible/formless argument into praise of Buddhism, retaining all historical distinctions and argument.
Used Vorhaben rather than business-suggesting Unternehmen for the Buddhist enterprise and distinguished the writer attribution from text ending and later collecting traces.
Removed ambiguous original before sheet, avoiding an unintended authenticity implication while keeping the explicit traditional attribution / Ming outline-and-fill copy distinction.

preservation: No quotations, supplied complete translations, arguments, examples, captions, references, image-source links, optional readings or rights statements removed. No changes to received originals.
observations: EP13 and EP14 distinguish the original stone's date and scale from the later rubbing album, its mounting and uncertain rubbing date.
EP15 retains explicit attribution caution and Niu Kecheng's identification of this Wuxi version as a Ming outline-and-fill copy; no competing version silently substituted.
EP16 retains uncertainty concerning Boyuan's identity, omitted grammatical subjects, the occasion, and mourning interpretation rather than adding a definite death or appointment narrative.
